text.en:
The sum of seven thousand pesos is hereby Appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the maintenance of twenty scholarships now existing in the College
of Veterinary Science of the University of the Philippines, in accordance with the provisions of section one of
Act Numbered Two thousand and forty.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 12, 1913.
